source.headDirtyScope: Admission tooling, tests, geometry/resource registries, and the W0 checkpoint only; no served product files differed from HEAD.

fixture.servers: Separate loopback no-store static servers for immutable base and HEAD product trees.
fixture.readiness: HTTP load completion, manifest primary-surface visibility when declared, document.fonts.ready, then two animation frames.
fixture.capture: Fresh browser context per source/cell with stored theme, full-page screenshot, animations disabled, and page/console error collection.
fixture.selection: Exact active geometry registry membership; no sampled or omitted admitted cells.

procedure.comparison: Ten causal-group contact sheets place base and head full-page captures side by side with exact cell labels.
procedure.reviewed: All ten contact sheets covering all 62 admitted cells were inspected against the documented source-cause table.
criteria: No altered intrinsic canvas or media dimensions
Expected source-caused movement or wrapping only

limitations: Agent visual and source review, not human or independent approval.
Not interaction, accessibility, assistive-technology, real-device, cross-browser, performance, or learner-outcome certification.
Local screenshots do not replace fresh same-runner CI reproduction of every exact reviewed cell.
The external evidence directory is retained locally and is not an application baseline.
